# Canopy v1.0.0

The first stable release of Canopy, a self-updating study library: a folder tree of lessons that one build script turns into a searchable, themeable static site. **Add a folder, run `npm run build`, and it shows up on the page.**

## Highlights

- **The library.** 5 categories, 33 subjects and 1,893 lessons across computer science, programming languages, web development, databases and cloud tooling. Every subject runs from junior to intermediate to senior.
- **The site.** Search, an A-Z jump bar, light and dark themes, per-subject progress kept in your browser, an offline fallback through a service worker, and a one-click `.zip` download of a subject. Plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with no runtime dependencies.
- **Self-updating.** The folder tree is the source of truth. Adding a lesson, stage or subject never touches `app.js`.
- **Browsable on GitHub.** The README shows a card per category, each opening a generated page for its subjects and a Stage | Lessons table per level.
- **Reproducible builds.** The content version is a hash of file contents, so a fresh clone rebuilds exactly what is committed. `npm run check` proves it.
- **Checked on every pull request.** Content validation, a generated-files sync check, oxlint, a test suite on Node 20 and 22, and CodeQL, plus branch and release-tag rulesets.
- **Documented.** A README, an authoring guide, an architecture write-up, deployment notes, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md` and a changelog.

## Stability

From 1.0.0 the folder layout, the `meta.json` fields and the `npm run` commands are the public contract. Changes that break them will come with a new major version; additions and fixes will not.

## Fixes made while preparing this release

- Removed 41 duplicate lesson and stage folders in the Docker and Git subjects (65 duplicate pages) and two stray, never-rendered pages in the machine-learning subject.
- Fixed a lesson-tab placeholder that wrote a `meta.json` title into the page without escaping it.
- Made the content version independent of file modification times.

## Downloads

`canopy-site-v1.0.0.zip` is the contents of `frontend/`: the finished site. Unzip it anywhere that serves static files. Nothing needs building.

## Before you deploy

- **GitHub Pages:** set **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source** to **GitHub Actions**. The branch-based option cannot serve `frontend/`.
- **Repository settings** the files cannot switch on for you: import the two rulesets from `.github/rulesets/`, enable private vulnerability reporting, and enable Dependabot alerts. See [docs/DEPLOYMENT.md](https://github.com/privateMwb/Canopy/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).

## Known limits

- Progress and theme live in `localStorage`, so they don't sync across devices.
- The site needs a network for Google Fonts and, for zip downloads, a pinned JSZip from cdnjs.
- Lessons have no deep links yet.
- Lessons open same-origin with the site, so they are trusted code. The validator rejects scripts, inline handlers and `javascript:` links; see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/privateMwb/Canopy/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/privateMwb/Canopy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
